title: Extension config
description: The data of an extension in `extensions/`.

$schema.description: The JSON schema of this file.

name.description: The extension's published identity: its `package.json` name is `code-spell-checker-<name>`. It doesn't change after the extension is published.

friendlyName.description: The name shown in VS Code and the Marketplace, e.g. `Swedish`.

displayName.description: The Marketplace name, e.g. `Swedish - Code Spell Checker`.

sample.description: The document opened by the VS Code test, relative to the extension.

cspell.description: The content of `static/cspell-ext.json`. The sync adds the `engines` the imported dictionaries declare. Set `engines` here only to override them or the defaults in `static/engines.json`.

notes.description: Notes for maintainers: why something in this file is the way it is.

locale.description: The language's primary locale, as a BCP 47 tag, e.g. `sv-SE`.

nativeName.description: The language's name in the language itself, e.g. `svenska`.

LanguageExtensionConfig.description: A natural language, enabled by its locale, e.g. Swedish.

action.description: Turn the toggle on or off.

toggle.description: What the command changes: a locale (`cSpell.language`) or a dictionary (`cSpell.dictionaries`).

value.description: The locale or the dictionary name.

id.description: The command ID, e.g. `cSpellExt_swedish.enable`. Unique within the extension.

title.description: The command title, e.g. `Enable Swedish Spell Checker Dictionary`.

contributes.description: Whether the command is listed in `package.json` (`contributes.commands`), the Command Palette and the README. A command that isn't is still registered, so keybindings and tasks that use its ID keep working. Default: `true`.

legacy.description: The command is a holdover from an old way of doing things, i.e. an old command ID. For maintainers.

notes.description: Notes for maintainers: why this command is the way it is.

CommandConfig.description: A command that turns a locale (`cSpell.language`) or a dictionary (`cSpell.dictionaries`) on or off.
